scope: Actual installed GGUF/Ollama inference tokenizer/template observations only, not approved training examples or native trainable tokenizer fit.

official_metric_reference.short_witness_prompt: Number of tokens in the prompt
official_metric_reference.short_witness_generation: Number of tokens generated in the response
official_metric_reference.interpretation: Prompt and generated counts are separate. Current docs distinguish cached prompt tokens; missing raw fields are unknown, not fabricated zero. This doc check does not certify identical behavior across every installed Ollama version.

confirmed_boundary: Every K completion is <=512 reported tokens, yet each prompt alone is2094–2653 tokens and total2509–3022. Completion-only/character proxies cannot establish full512training-pair fit. The exact future trainable tokenizer/template remains unknown.
same_base_requirement: Current inference digest/format cannot substitute for the same unadapted trainable base in future baseline/adapted comparison.

time_budget_observation.limits: Arithmetic for this installed CPU Docker inference workload only; not native training forecast, guaranteed future budget or reason to raise ceilings. Actual total must include semantic scoring and preservation.
